At 7.03 a.m. on Tuesday, Dr. Eleanor Vile stepped onto platform 4B with a canvas satchel, two overwrite pairs, and a note that read, Meet me at the old clock. No, not that clock. The station announcer, speaking in a calm but faintly metallic voice, said, The 705 service to St. Ives, via Northbridge, will depart from platform 4.
